title: Review repairs (contracts): negatives assert their reason, one TS validator, strict credential readers, wipe threshold from the substrate, guard controls per guard, manifest gaps recorded
description:
Final review of epic 692 (no blockers). Fix these should-fix items; they change contracts/*.json and readers, so YOU own the bundle bump (contracts/CHANGELOG.md entry, make contracts-bundle, pin moved). A sibling tick edits docs/claims in README/CHANGELOG prose concurrently: expect to merge CHANGELOG/README with it and keep both.
5. contracts/ticfac-run-state.json invalid[] and credential-ownership.json negatives carry a why sentence but no expect_error_contains, so a negative can fail for the wrong reason and stay green. Add expect_error_contains to every negative in both files and assert it in both readers, as job-protocol.json already does (jobprotocol/contract_test.go:357-362, job-protocol.test.ts:204-209).
8. contracts/job-protocol.json:1024-1062 golden "a review-role check with no process" has role review-epic with phase review, tick_id abc, an attempt branch as source_ref, integration_ref null, acceptance advisory. SPEC §6.3 defines review-epic as running against the integrated EpicRun ref and as required. Make the golden epic-level (tick_id null, integration_ref set, acceptance required) or relabel the role.
9. credential-ownership.json is the only contract using schema keywords outside the strict subset (oneOf, const, minLength, format, pattern), so both readers are hand-rolled and lenient: unknown keywords are ignored on both sides and format: uri differs between Go and TS. Rewrite the schema in the strict subset (internal/tkcontract/schema.go keywords) and validate it with the strict validators on both sides; drop the hand-rolled readers.
10. Three strict-subset validators exist: internal/tkcontract/schema.go (Go), cloud/factory/test/json-schema.ts (mirrors Go exactly, incl. error text), cloud/factory/test/schema-subset.ts (weaker: required uses "in", keyword values not type-checked, divergent error text, no unknown-keyword test). Delete schema-subset.ts and point ticfac-run-state.test.ts at json-schema.ts. Also parse every schema in tk-json-manifest.json with the strict TS validator in tk-json-manifest.test.ts (today it only checks $refs resolve).
11. contracts/lifecycle-invariants.json pins wipe 600000 / max_poll 300000 and asserts 2*poll <= wipe, but nothing ties them to the substrate: MAX_POLL_MS (run-workflow.ts:225) is not imported and the real sleep is SANDBOX_SLEEP_AFTER = "20m" (sandbox.ts:274). 600000 is WORKFLOW_STEP_TIMEOUT_MS, not the wipe threshold. Make the TS reader import MAX_POLL_MS and SANDBOX_SLEEP_AFTER (parse the duration) from the source and assert the fixture equals them; keep the Go side asserting the fixture relation. The fixture must not be a third copy of the number.
12. Negative controls disable all of an invariant guards together; for two-guard invariants (A1, A13) a dead guard is masked. Make the control per guard (disable one at a time, require divergence each time) on both sides, and assert the other invariants stay green while one guard is disabled. Move A10 protected prefixes (.tick/, .ticfac/) from the harness code into the JSON. Reword root CHANGELOG "proven to bite" only if you cannot make it true.
13. SPEC §3.1 lists tk sandbox image|setup|substrate|worker-prompt --json and tk ask --json; no sandbox subcommand registers --json and tk ask --json means read-from-stdin. Record the gap: manifest $comment lists the SPEC commands not published and why; fix SPEC §3.1 list to match the manifest (and tk graph --json needs <epic-id>); README:135-174 likewise. Do NOT implement new --json flags here.
Bundle bump per contracts/CHANGELOG.md rule (schema shape of credential-ownership changes → MAJOR 3.0.0 is honest; nothing outside cloud/factory pins yet).
Run in the FOREGROUND: make contracts-bundle-check, go test -short ./internal/contracts/ ./internal/factory/... ./internal/tkcontract/ ./cmd/tk/..., cloud/factory pnpm contracts:check, pnpm contracts:test, pnpm exec tsc --noEmit, pnpm exec vitest run test/.
acceptance_criteria: Every negative example in every contract carries expect_error_contains asserted by both readers; exactly one TS strict-subset validator exists and every schema-bearing contract (incl. tk-json-manifest) is parsed by a strict validator on both sides; credential-ownership.json validates under the strict subset; the lifecycle wipe/poll numbers are asserted equal to the substrate constants in TS; per-guard negative controls on both sides; A10 prefixes live in the JSON; manifest and SPEC §3.1 agree; bundle bumped with pin moved; the listed commands pass.
